raw.title: Fix/sync lockfile packaged lock
raw.body:
This is an AI-authored commit, but a human-written PR comment.

NPM does not include `package-lock.json` when installing from GitHub, but we want to be able to check it.  This creates a copy and infrastructure to update it and ensure that all PRs include an up-to-date copy.  The last commit in this PR ensures there is a specific task with a clear error message to flag that failure rather than having to interpret a unit test (although there is also a  unit test for this).  Documentation updates are included.
